newsitem.title: USA: Highwoods buys rest of Crocker Realty.
newsitem.headline: Highwoods buys rest of Crocker Realty.

text.p: Highwoods Properties Inc. said Monday it completed its acquisition of Crocker Realty Trust Inc., paying about $73.7 million for the remaining 23 percent of Crocker stock it did not already own.

Highwoods, a self-administered real estate investment trust that purchased 77 percent of Crocker's outstanding shares Sept. 6, said it completed the acquisition last Friday, after Crocker stockholder approval.
The $73.7 million it paid for the remaining 23 percent of Crocker includes the purchase of 2.1 million common shares that were issued upon exercise of outstanding warrants.

Highwoods, which is based in Raleigh, N.C., owns 275 suburban office, industrial, and service centre properties in the Southeast, primarily in North Carolina, Tennessee, Florida, Virginia, South Carolina, Georgia, and Alabama.
Crocker, formerly Southeast Realty Corp., owns about 50 office or service properties in the same states. It is based in Boca Raton, Fla.
Highwoods' stock lost 25 cents to $29.375 in early afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
